$comment: QA's standard test policy. The collection generator reads this to decide which test templates are injected into which requests. Each generated request is tagged (happy-path, missing-auth, malformed-body, unknown-resource, empty-results, create) and templates are matched against those tags.

policies.rationale: Every request gets a latency budget so slow regressions surface in the QA run.
Every endpoint must return { error: { code, message } } on failure; passes trivially on success.
Happy-path requests assert their exact expected status code and JSON content type.
Happy-path responses with a declared shape must contain all expected fields.
Every authenticated endpoint gets a no-token negative request expecting 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
Unknown IDs must return 403/404 with the standard error shape, never a 500.
Endpoints that accept a body get a malformed-body negative request expecting 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with field details.
Search endpoints must treat zero matches as 200 + empty array, never 404.
Create endpoints must return 201 with an ID; the ID is saved as a collection variable for chained requests.
